data.title: Probation Period & Post-Start Confirmation
data.content:
# Probation Period & Post-Start Confirmation

The post-hire evaluation interval (statutory or contractual probation) during which performance, delivery, and team alignment are formally confirmed.

### Pass Condition
The applicable probation interval ends without a valid probation-based termination, and employment continues under the governing contract and law.

specimens.label: Probation review milestone

lines.text: Day 1–60: Objectives assigned, delivery metrics tracked
Day 90: Formal probation sign-off review by engineering manager
Status: Probation review completed; employment continues

specimens.reading: Completion may be recorded by an explicit review or follow from the interval expiring under the applicable rule; employment did not begin only at this milestone.

perspectives.sees: Direct on-the-job execution during the first three months, assessing delivery speed, architecture decisions, and team communication.
perspectives.reads: A probation clause may provide a specific evaluation and termination procedure where the governing law and contract allow it.
perspectives.does: Conducts regular 1-on-1 reviews and files the final probation confirmation report.

perspectives.sees: Initial project onboarding, ramp-up expectations, and milestone checkpoints toward passing probation.
perspectives.reads: Employment already exists; probation may change particular notice or termination rules but does not postpone every employment right.
perspectives.does: Delivers against sprint goals and seeks written confirmation upon completion of the probation interval.

perspectives.sees: Legal compliance boundaries (statutory 3-month caps under the Ukrainian Labour Code, or contractual notice rules under the UK Employment Rights Act 1996).
perspectives.reads: Only the protections or procedures expressly varied by applicable law or contract change during probation; other rights remain in force.
perspectives.does: Checks that the clause, duration, notice, reasons, and recorded outcome comply with the applicable regime.
